SBI confirms customer data exposure on dark web

State Bank of India (SBI) has confirmed that records of 3,897 customers were found on the dark web. The exposed data includes customer names and phone numbers. The bank reported a suspected cyberattack that led to this exposure. The incident involved the potential compromise of customer records, which were subsequently discovered on the dark web.
